title: SpiceXplorer per-circuit DUT parameterization (atomic inventory + declarative tying)
description: abstract/params.yaml — separates what CAN vary from what SHOULD vary together (meta doc/plan_parameterization.md). `devices:` is the exhaustive atomic per-instance inventory (a physical fact of the topology, GENERATED from abstract/topology.cgraph.json); `groups:`/`ratios:` are the shipped DEFAULT tying (design intent, tagged with machine-readable reasons) that an upstream user may accept, edit, or dissolve by category — without re-authoring the abstract netlist. Settled P0 decisions (plan §4): per-finger (w, m) is canonical — total-W is a derived convenience, never stored; generation lives in the analog-db CLI (`gen-params`, P1) with circuitgraph as the detector; ties lower to `.param` lines referencing the FIRST member's atomic symbols — group names stay a YAML-level concept and never appear in decks.

devices.description: Atomic inventory — one entry per netlist instance, keys are instance ids from the circuitgraph (XM1, C1, …). Each value maps that instance's SPICE parameter fields (w/l/m for MOS; c/r/… for passives) to its mechanically-derived atomic symbol (`x_dut_<id>_<field>`, plan D-1 — the `x_dut_` prefix is display-only grouping) or to a frozen numeric literal. Exhaustive: every parameterizable field of every instance appears here (Tier-1 verified, P1).

groups.description: Shipped DEFAULT tying — recommendations, not topology. Each group ties one or more fields across its members; the `kind` tag is the upstream affordance (dissolve ties by category, e.g. "keep pairs matched, untie all mirror Ls"). Lowering (P2) emits one `.param <member_symbol> = {<first_member_symbol>}` line per tied field for every non-first member.

name.description: YAML-level handle (addressable by `dut_params` / `ungroup:` upstream, D-5); never appears in lowered decks.

kind.description: Machine-readable WHY: matched_pair = symmetric same-polarity pair (diff pair, mirror load halves) tying full geometry; mirror_length = current-mirror members sharing L for ratio accuracy; bias_chain = devices tracking a bias branch; shared_geometry = author-opinion sharing with no single structural cause (the escape hatch for legacy global ties).

members.description: Instance ids; each MUST exist in `devices:` (Tier-1, D-6). Order matters: the FIRST member's atomic symbols are the tie targets in lowered decks.

tie.description: The parameter fields tied across members (e.g. [w, l, m] for a matched pair, [l] for a mirror).

ratios.description: Mirror gains as data: param(ref) = param(of) × ratio. Frozen constants by default; `is_integer: true` exposes the ratio as an integer knob instead (per-PDK bounds then live in sizing.yaml, D-4).

param.description: The derived field — normally m (per-finger w stays canonical; total-W scales via m, plan §4-1).

ref.description: The DERIVED instance (the mirror output); must exist in `devices:`.

of.description: The base instance (the diode-connected reference); must exist in `devices:`.

ratio.description: Exact fraction as a string ("17/3") or a number. param(ref) = param(of) × ratio.

is_integer.description: Expose as an integer knob instead of a frozen constant (default false).
